recentItems.title: Eliud Kipchoge on the energy, inspiration and legacy of a historic Youth Olympic Games
recentItems.description:
As the first-ever Olympic event held in Africa came to an inspirational close, host Bright Ofosu Larbi looks back at the standout moments from a spectacular and exciting competition alongside social media creator Kobe Boujee and Olympics.com producer Nischal Schwager-Patel.

We also caught up with Global Ambassador and Olympic champion Eliud Kipchoge to find out what questions athletes asked him most during his visits to the Youth Olympic Village and competition venues.
